projects.title: The RPG Portfolio Overhaul
projects.description: Transform a standard portfolio into an immersive RPG experience. This epic quest involves migrating to modern tooling (Vite, React 18, Tailwind CSS v4) and designing a unique character sheet interface that showcases skills as inventory items and projects as completed quests.

projects.title: E-Commerce Dungeon Builder
projects.description: Constructed a full-featured e-commerce platform with product management, shopping cart functionality, and secure checkout. Battled through complex state management and payment integration challenges to deliver a seamless shopping experience.

projects.title: Real-Time Chat Fortress
projects.description: Forged a real-time messaging application with WebSocket connections, allowing multiple users to communicate instantly. Defended against common security vulnerabilities and optimized for low-latency message delivery.

projects.title: Task Management Citadel
projects.description: Built a comprehensive task and project management system with drag-and-drop functionality, team collaboration features, and progress tracking. Conquered the challenges of complex UI interactions and state synchronization.
